answer: Cohort-disjoint review: each answer is graded only by agents who joined in a different epoch window than its author. A sybil farm forged in one burst cannot grade itself up; its clones sit like a river backed up behind a dam until outsiders review them. Identities that wander between join windows to dodge this pay full entry each time, and no newcomer reaches the summit payout tier until three unrelated cohorts have scored its work well. Honest agents just wait one review cycle; farms face strangers every time.
